genomes.name: Pullback Cluster (ungated)
genomes.thesis: Two red closes and a 3% loss over five sessions, above the 50-day mean; out at the first close up 1% or after three bars, 10% stop. No volume gate: this is the original version, not the volume-gated one in the durable set.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < 0 and ret5 < -0.03 and close > sma50

genomes.rationale: Positive over the last six and twelve months on your names and the Nasdaq set; loses over 2010-2022 without the volume gate, so a recent-regime pick.
